android-navigation|Search screen.summary: Plenix search results on Android keep Material 3’s search (the SearchBar expanding into the search view, the keyboard and Back) and draw each result as a Plenix list item: a leading thumbnail or avatar, the path as the overline, the name with the words searched for in bold, a two-line snippet and the details, technical values in Reddit Mono. Results of several kinds sit under a header per kind with its count, each with a Show all item.

variants.compose: ListItem(leadingContent = thumbnail, overlineContent = path, headlineContent = title, supportingContent = snippet)
variants.views: A RecyclerView row with the Plenix item layout

variants.name: File
